frequency_question: How often do structural frictions (such as mandatory conciliation processes, high-level government intervention, court injunctions, or last-minute settlements under statutory labor machinery) successfully avert an announced indefinite strike?
membership_rule: Includes all officially called nationwide or industry-wide indefinite strike actions by major bank employee/officer confederations in nationalized banking sectors where conciliation proceedings were invoked. Excludes local or single-bank wildcat strikes.
coverage_note: 8 major national bank strike notices identified with clear conciliation/structural intervention outcomes; estimated 12 total in the timeframe.
known_gaps: Minor regional actions excluded; focus strictly on industry-wide indefinite calls facing statutory conciliation friction.
validity_reason: Labor laws governing conciliation and industrial disputes in the jurisdiction remain stable over multi-year periods.
